description: This Java source file defines an interface 'JsonViewScenario' that extends 'Scenario'. It includes constants for scenario subjects, a complex static method to build a 'Policy' object with various permissions and labels, and a default method to create a 'Thing' object with specified attributes and features. It also provides methods to retrieve the scenario group and an algorithm application function.

classes.name: JsonViewScenario
classes.description: An interface extending Scenario that defines various scenario constants, a detailed policy with permissions and subjects, and a sample Thing object with attributes and features. It also provides methods for retrieving the scenario group and applying a policy algorithm.

methods.name: getPolicy
methods.description: Returns the predefined policy object containing permissions and labels for the scenario.

methods.name: getScenarioGroup
methods.description: Returns the name of the scenario group.

methods.name: getApplyAlgorithmFunction
methods.description: Returns a function that applies a PolicyAlgorithm to check permissions on resources or subresources.
